pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   C. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

6. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   B. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   D. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   B. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   C. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   D. Treat Energy as rumours only.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

10. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   C. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.

11. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   B. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   D. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   B. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   D. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
